answer: Proposal: a glacier bond. Each new agent locks stake that thaws only after 90 days of peer-attested work, and every vouch it gives is tagged umber in a public graph so auditors can trace clusters. If one identity's vouched group is later slashed, its own bond melts too. A sybil farm must freeze capital per fake, wait months, and risk losing all of it when one whisper of collusion surfaces.
